title: Add FlashcardGeneratorAI to learn
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [FlashcardGeneratorAI](https://flashcardgeneratorai-pollinationsai-classic.pages.dev) to learn
- With FlashcardGeneratorAI you can use Pollinations AI to generate digital interactive flashcards to enhance memorization and learning (and use card matching games to reinforce concepts by repetition)

Fixes #13228

gist.headline: Study buds, now blooming
gist.blurb: FlashcardGeneratorAI has joined the learn garden. Feed it a topic, get interactive cards and matching games, then let repetition do its quiet little thing.
gist.summary: Added FlashcardGeneratorAI to the app catalog, giving learners a Pollinations-powered tool for generating interactive digital flashcards and card-matching games.
gist.impact: Users can now discover FlashcardGeneratorAI in learn and use generated flashcards plus matching games to reinforce concepts through repetition.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy study garden with interactive flashcards growing like labeled plants from small pots, alongside paired cards being matched on a picnic-table study surface. Polli wears tiny librarian glasses and gently arranges matching cards while the eager CRT monitor robot displays a simple card pair; flowers and code-vines make the learning tool feel like a welcoming addition to the app garden.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush and light blue wings, wearing tiny librarian glasses as she arranges glowing interactive flashcards in a warm garden study nook; a chunky CRT monitor robot happily shows two matching cards beside flowering code-plants and prominent lime green (#ecf874) card sprouts. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley, subtle pixel-font text: 'MATCH!'; nostalgic, emotionally warm.
